phrases: fly off course
表示偏离航线
The plane flew off course due to the bad weather.
由于恶劣天气，飞机偏离了航线。
in the middle of winter
表示在隆冬时节
It happened in the middle of winter when it was very cold.
事情发生在非常寒冷的隆冬时节。
turn into
表示把...变成...
She turned a suitcase into a bed for the children.
她把手提箱变成了孩子们的床。
keep as near as possible to
表示尽可能靠近...
The woman kept as near as possible to her children.
那位妇女尽可能靠近她的孩子们。
early next morning
表示第二天一大早
Early next morning, she heard planes passing overhead.
第二天一大早，她听到飞机从头顶飞过。
pass overhead
表示从头顶飞过
Planes passed overhead but no one saw her.
飞机从头顶飞过，但没有人看到她。
send a message
表示发送消息
The pilot sent a message by radio to the nearest town.
飞行员通过无线电向最近的城镇发送了消息。
not long before
表示不久之后
It was not long before a helicopter arrived.
不久之后，一架直升机赶到了。
have an idea
表示想出一个主意
Then she had an idea to stamp out letters in the snow.
然后她想出了一个主意：在雪地上踩出字母。
rescue the survivors
表示营救幸存者
The helicopter came to rescue the survivors of the crash.
直升机赶来营救坠机事故中的幸存者。

grammar.d: 表示在过去某个特定时间发生的动作或存在的状态 用于叙述过去发生的事情，描述一系列按时间顺序发生的动作
ex: The plane crashed in the mountains.
She turned a suitcase into a bed.

grammar.d: 表示在过去某一时刻正在进行的动作 用于描述过去正在发生的动作，常与过去进行时连用或用于设置故事背景
ex: She was turning a suitcase into a bed when it grew dark.
天黑时她正在把手提箱变成床。
The children were sleeping in the case.

grammar.f: 主语 + had + 过去分词
grammar.d: 表示在过去某一时刻之前已经完成的动作 用于叙述过去事件时，表示两个过去的动作中较早发生的那个
ex: When the pilot saw the signal, a message had already been sent.
当飞行员看到信号时，消息已经被发出了。
She had covered the children with clothes before it got cold.
在天变冷之前她已经给孩子们盖上了衣服。

patterns.p: When + 过去时态, 主语 + 过去时态
o: When it grew dark, she turned a suitcase into a bed.
当夜幕降临时，她把手提箱变成了床。
im: When it started to rain, we went inside.
当开始下雨时，我们走进了室内。
When he arrived home, his wife was cooking dinner.
当他到家时，他的妻子正在做晚饭。

patterns.p: 主语 + had + 过去分词 + before + 主语 + 过去时态
o: She had covered them with all the clothes she could find before it got cold.
在天变冷之前，她用尽所有能找到的衣服给孩子们盖上。
im: He had finished his homework before his father came back.
在他父亲回来之前，他已经完成了作业。
The pilot had sent a message before the helicopter arrived.
在直升机到达之前，飞行员已经发送了消息。

patterns.p: It is/was not long before + 主语 + 过去时态
o: It was not long before a helicopter arrived on the scene.
不久之后，一架直升机到达了现场。
im: It was not long before the doctor arrived.
It was not long before the train left the station.
不久之后火车就离开了车站。

patterns.p: 主语 + 动词 + the letters + '...' + in + 地点
o: She stamped out the letters 'SOS' in the snow.
她在雪地上踩出了'SOS'字母。
im: The children drew the word 'HELP' in the sand.
孩子们在沙地上画了'HELP'这个词。
He wrote the word 'SAVE' on the ground with a stick.
他用树枝在地上写了'SAVE'这个词。
